title: Single-complex criterion for derived direct-image base change
statement: Let f:X\to S be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], let g:T\to S be any morphism, and write g':X_T\to X and f_T:X_T\to T for the cartesian base-change square [def-pc-base-change]. Let E\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X) [def-pc-derived-category] and let G^\bullet be a bounded-above complex of quasi-coherent \mathcal O_X-modules. Assume that for every x'\in X_T, with x=g'(x'), s=f(x), and t=f_T(x'), and every i\in\mathbf Z, the canonical map from the stalkwise base-change condition H^i(G_x^\bullet\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_{S,s}}\mathcal O_{T,t})\otimes_{\mathcal O_{X,x}\otimes_{\mathcal O_{S,s}}\mathcal O_{T,t}}\mathcal O_{X_T,x'} to H^i(((g')^*G^\bullet)_{x'}) is an isomorphism [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Then the canonical base-change map Lg^*Rf_*(E\otimes^L G^\bullet)\to Rf_{T,*}(L(g')^*E\otimes^L (g')^*G^\bullet) [def-pc-derived-direct-image] is an isomorphism in D(\mathcal O_T).

proof.text: Use Tag 0DJA(1) for the canonical map L(g')^*G^bullet \to (g')^*G^bullet and the given E. It gives the same stalkwise condition for the induced map L(g')^*(E \otimes^L G^bullet) \to L(g')^*E \otimes^L (g')^*G^bullet.

Apply the qcqs single-complex base-change statement to K = E \otimes^L G^bullet and K' = L(g')^*E \otimes^L (g')^*G^bullet. Step 1 supplies its stalkwise hypothesis, so the composite Lg^*Rf_*(E \otimes^L G^bullet) \to Rf_{T,*}L(g')^*(E \otimes^L G^bullet) \to Rf_{T,*}(L(g')^*E \otimes^L (g')^*G^bullet) is an isomorphism.
The displayed composite is the canonical base-change map in the statement, by the definition of the derived pullback of a tensor product and functoriality of the comparison maps.
